import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fixture = repo / 'tests/fixtures/compiler_phase_lockin'

def run_json(args, expect_rc):
    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', *args, '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    assert proc.returncode == expect_rc, (args, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
    return payload

check_payload = run_json(['check', str(fixture)], 0)
assert check_payload['errors'] == 0, check_payload
verify_payload = run_json(['verify', str(fixture)], 0)
assert verify_payload['errors'] == 0, verify_payload
build_payload = run_json(['build', str(fixture), '--backend', 'llvm'], 0)
assert build_payload['status'] == 'ok', build_payload
assert build_payload['dependencyGraphHash'], build_payload
parity_payload = run_json(['parity', str(fixture), '--seed', '4242'], 0)
assert parity_payload['ok'] is True, parity_payload
assert parity_payload['checks']['sameVerifierResult'] is True, parity_payload
assert parity_payload['checks']['sameRuntimeBehavior'] is True, parity_payload

root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-phase-cache-'))
(root / 'src/services').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]\nname="compiler_phase_cache"\nversion="0.1.0"\n\n[[target.bin]]\nname="compiler_phase_cache"\npath="src/main.fzy"\n')
(root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('use core.term;\nmod services;\nfn main() -> i32 {\n    discard term.write("cache-check\\n")\n    return services.boot()\n}\n')
(root / 'src/services/mod.fzy').write_text('pub fn boot() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
assert run_json(['check', str(root)], 0)['errors'] == 0
(root / 'src/services/mod.fzy').write_text('pub fn renamed() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
broken_check = run_json(['check', str(root)], 0)
assert broken_check['errors'] > 0, broken_check
assert any('unresolved call target `services.boot`' in item['message'] for item in broken_check['items']), broken_check
broken_verify = run_json(['verify', str(root)], 0)
assert broken_verify['errors'] > 0, broken_verify
broken_build = run_json(['build', str(root), '--backend', 'llvm'], 0)
assert broken_build['status'] == 'error', broken_build
(root / 'src/services/mod.fzy').write_text('pub fn boot() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
repaired_build = run_json(['build', str(root), '--backend', 'llvm'], 0)
assert repaired_build['status'] == 'ok', repaired_build

invalid = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-phase-invalid-'))
(invalid / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(invalid / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]\nname="compiler_phase_invalid"\nversion="0.1.0"\n\n[[target.bin]]\nname="compiler_phase_invalid"\npath="src/main.fzy"\n')
(invalid / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('fn main( -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
for command in (['check', str(invalid)], ['verify', str(invalid)], ['build', str(invalid), '--backend', 'llvm']):
    payload = run_json(command, 0)
    assert payload['errors'] > 0 or payload.get('status') == 'error', (command, payload)

print('compiler-phase-lockin-ok')
